_meta.purpose: Design-document scenarios that no test claims, and why.

kinds.visual: Cannot be verified headlessly. Needs a stated reason and the committed capture that covers it, or the milestone that will produce one.
kinds.deferred: Not yet due. Needs the milestone that owns it.

_meta.the_other_kind: A scenario VERIFIED by a test is not listed here. Its claim lives beside the test, as a '# @covers <Feature> / <Scenario>' line, so it moves with the code it describes.
_meta.matching: Feature and scenario text are quoted from the design document VERBATIM. check_spec_coverage.py requires a bijection, so rewording a heading in the document breaks every claim on it — deliberately. A fuzzy match would absorb the rename silently, which is the failure the gate exists to prevent.
_meta.honesty: The gate can check that every scenario is claimed and that a deferral names a milestone. It CANNOT check that a deferred scenario really belongs to the milestone named, nor that a verified claim's test really tests that scenario. Those are review's job — see design D4 of add-determinism-and-coverage-harness.

entries.scenario: Viewing the kart before the start

entries.reason: Requires seeing that grass is still visible beyond the kart and that no wall or ground edge is drawn. Nothing about that is measurable from state.
entries.note: Captured through the camera the design document specifies, with the kart driven into the boundary and rebounding — z=89.997, v=-0.00165, reported by the capture tool. The scenario is still UNMET: the document requires that no edge of the ground be visible, and its own numbers (+/-100 wu plane, +/-90 drivable extent, fog from 50 wu) put the edge five times nearer than fog reaches. From this viewpoint the grass-to-sky transition reads as a plain horizon with no wall, fence or discontinuity, which is the most favourable evidence so far — and still M6's decision on the whole look rather than one frame. Ambiguity A11, att 15. An earlier note said the kart-height capture 'waits for the chase camera'; it has shipped, and this is it. docs/progress/2026-08-29-m2-boundary.png remains as the elevated oblique view, where the same geometry reads as an edge.

entries.scenario: Recording a lap slower than the best
Restarting the clock after a lap
Persisting the best time for the session
Ordering the work within a frame
entries.note: The scenario requires the camera, the minimap re-centre AND the HUD update to be ordered after post-physics, and closes on the kart's position, the speedometer and the minimap marker agreeing within a frame. Neither a minimap nor a HUD exists before M5, which owns that clause almost verbatim. M2 can verify at most the physics-then-camera half.
